notes.title: Version 1.0.5 patch notes
notes.notes:
- Lots of small changes to the UI
- Fixed a bug which prevented an achievement from triggering

notes.title: Now available on Mac and Linux
notes.notes: A Story of a Band works now also on Mac and Linux (SteamOS, Ubuntu etc). If you have Steam Cloud enabled, your game progress and save files will be automatically synced and available on all supported platforms.
